text: 在政策红利、增量资金预期、底层资产扩容三重利好的共振下，科创债板块行情走强，科创债ETF也迎来资金的持续抢筹。8月以来，24只科创债ETF净申购份额超过1亿份，规模大增132亿元。业内人士认为，随着债券市场“科技板”建设的推进，科创债的供给与机构配置空间有望进一步打开，长期配置价值将持续显现。(上证报)
text_en: Driven by the combined benefits of policy incentives, expectations of incremental capital and expansion of underlying assets, the sci-tech innovation bond sector has strengthened, and sci-tech innovation bond ETFs have also seen continuous capital inflows. Since August, 24 sci-tech innovation bond ETFs have seen net subscription shares exceeding 100 million units, with their scale surging by 13.2 billion yuan. Industry insiders believe that with the advancement of the bond market's "sci-tech board" construction, the supply of sci-tech innovation bonds and institutional allocation space are expected to further expand, and their long-term allocation value will continue to emerge. (Shanghai Securities News)
